Without new supply, inventory of 176 units runs out on 2026-09-27, creating 300 units of unmet demand over the 28-day horizon.

args.rationale:
The purchasing recommendation of 800 units is modified to 500 units. The baseline analysis shows current usable stock of 176 units and daily forecast demand of 17 units/day (totaling 476 units over 28 days), leading to a stockout on 2026-09-27 and total unmet demand of 300 units.

The recommended quantity of 800 units is infeasible because it violates storage capacity constraints (peak occupancy 204.00 m³ vs 200.00 m³ limit) and max days of cover policy (29.4 days vs 12.0 days limit).

Ordering 500 units from supplier SUP-A at $13.00 per unit ($6,500.00 total) with a 7-day lead time expected on 2026-09-24 completely eliminates unmet demand (0 residual unmet units). It stays within storage capacity (peak occupancy 198.00 m³), respects the maximum days cover policy (closing inventory 200 units = 11.8 days cover), satisfies MOQ (250 units) and pack size (50 units), and fits within the available budget of $50,000.00. Because total spend exceeds the $2,000.00 autonomy limit, buyer approval is required.
